subject: MSA review + triage call — onboarding evidence
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@tidewater.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@tidewater.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MSA review + triage call — onboarding evidence

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. We've uploaded the latest MSA (v3) with our internal annotations and pulled together an evidence pack for the onboarding items you requested. Would like to schedule a short triage call to go through:

- Key contract items we flagged (sections 4, 7, 11)
- Evidence artifacts for SOC/PCI checklist we will hand off
- Rollout timeline + any procurement gating items

Proposed 30–40 minute windows (PST):
- Mon 11/15 10:00–10:40
- Tue 11/16 11:00–11:40
- Wed 11/17 09:30–10:10

If none of those work, happy to take a few times that suit your legal/procurement leads. I've attached: Tidewater_MSA_v3_annotated.pdf and Tidewater_Evidence_Pack_v1.zip.

Attendees from our side: Liam O'Connor (legal), Sarah Nguyen (procurement).

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Connor
Counsel, Tidewater Health
liam.oconnor@tidewater.ai

Attachments: Tidewater_MSA_v3_annotated.pdf (pdf), Tidewater_Evidence_Pack_v1.zip (zip)

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MSA review + triage call — onboarding evidence

Thanks Liam — appreciate the materials. 30–40 minutes sounds right. Quick items before we lock a slot: 

1) Can you confirm whether the annotated MSA is the version you expect us to route for redlines (i.e., "final internal draft v3")?
2) Please include any vendor contact who can speak to the SOC evidence sections (we'll need someone on the call who understands the artifacts).
3) Our availability (PST): Mon 11/15 13:00–14:00, Tue 11/16 09:00–10:00, Wed 11/17 11:00–12:00.

If you can do Mon 11/15 13:30–14:00 that works for our legal and procurement. In the meantime I'll pull together a short prep packet for Tidewater and attach my notes.

Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

Attachment: OLGA-TDW-PrepNotes.docx (docx)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MSA review + triage call — onboarding evidence

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding Tidewater's packet and my notes. Please review the prep doc and flag any items you want covered on the call (I highlighted: liability cap language, indemnity scope, data residency clause in sec 7, and the "backup retention" line on p.12).

Prep ask:
- Marissa: can you bring procurement stance on payment terms and PO/contracting cadence?
- Rishi: please pull the last SOC report link and confirm whether the evidence pack maps to our requirements.

I'll tentatively hold Mon 11/15 13:30–14:00 on my calendar but will only finalize after Liam confirms.

Thanks — O.
